findings.title: Accounts removed before failure-retained secret tree
findings.evidence: cleanup deletes created users/groups, then removes T only when error==NONE. On any acceptance error the writer-owned bootstrap.json and PG-owned init-password/data stay while owning identities may be deleted. Secret-bearing orphan UID/GID paths remain.
findings.required_fix: Preserve safe failure diagnostics under root-private ownership, then remove or root-protect all secret-bearing UID-owned new paths before deleting identities. Do not sign identities/files cleanup complete when that ordering is unresolved.

findings.title: Bootstrap controller timeout lacks retained-resource cleanup fallback
findings.evidence: Timeout path terminates/kills only the controller; exception path logs failure and returns. Controller disables its alarm before cleanup, and inherited call uses select then blocking readline. A stalled cleanup/partial frame can exceed the grace and leave owned PG/API/writer children and newly created accounts/groups. Prepare/start failures also retain T without a defined safe fallback.
findings.required_fix: Add bounded complete-frame I/O and an explicit retained-instance bootstrap/controller cleanup protocol with deadlines and fail/unknown reporting. Preserve diagnostics, refuse unknown deletion; never imply controller termination cleans descendants/accounts.

findings.title: Protected copy dereferences source symlinks before checking copied objects
findings.evidence: shutil.copytree(...,symlinks=False) and copyfile read source/link targets first, while lstat protection only checks resulting target nodes. It cannot enforce approved refusal of source symlinks or original owner/mode/source provenance.
findings.required_fix: Validate each original source and ancestor with lstat/root ownership/nonwritable/regular directory or file requirements; reject symlinks before copy and retain bounded complete protected-source checks.

findings.title: Fixed persistent claim outside approved new T
findings.evidence: CLAIM is /tmp/parkweave-host-case-security-once-20261013.claim, written before creating T and never removed; current action checklist limits mutations to new T. O_EXCL/no-follow600 improve safety but do not extend user authorization.
findings.required_fix: Move claim under approved new T or explicitly list this exact extra object and lifetime in the pending approval before execution.
